item.title: Kaspa Credential Verification MVP Build
item.description:
250-750 USD | I’m ready to move EduTrace from concept to a working MVP on the Kaspa blockchain and need a builder who can make that happen. The focus for this first milestone is a simple, web-based verification portal where anyone can drop in a credential hash and instantly confirm its authenticity on-chain.
Core scope • Build Kaspa-powered anchoring logic that writes credential proofs (UTXOs) using SilverScript covenants. • Support issuance and verification for educational diplomas, transcripts, and certificates right from day one. • Design both institution and student workflows: schools must be able to issue and revoke, while graduates should download or share proofs for employers. • Expose a clean front-end that shows status, timestamp, and tamper-proof evidence in seconds.
Acceptance criteria • One-click issuance writes a verifiable Kaspa transaction; hash, timestamp, and metadata are queryable. • Verification portal returns a validated / invalid / revoked state under three seconds. • All three document types process end-to-end without manual intervention. • Codebase and covenant scripts are handed over with clear README and setup instructions so I can redeploy independently.
If you already speak Kaspa and have experimented with SilverScript covenants, you’ll feel right at home. If you’re just eager to dive in and can prove past UTXO-based projects, that works too. After the MVP goes live, I plan to extend EduTrace into physical asset tokenization, so there’s plenty of room to grow the engagement. Let’s get this portal live.

Quality and handover • Tested and polished on iPhone as well as desktop and tablet; screenshots of each at sign-off • Basic on-page SEO (Yoast or Rank Math, free tier), free caching and image optimisation compatible with Fasthosts, and UpdraftPlus (free) for backups • A short screen-recorded handover showing me how to edit text, swap images and reorder sections without breaking the mobile layout • All accounts and licences in my name; your WordPress admin account removed at completion
To quote, please send: • Two or three live links to institutional or professional-services sites you built in Kadence, saying which parts you designed and which came from a template • A fixed price, with delivery in two milestones: (1) the home/hero section on staging; (2) the full site live

item.title: Modern WooCommerce Music Store Build
item.description:
750-1500 USD | I need a fresh, modern-looking WordPress site powered by WooCommerce where I can sell my original music as individual tracks and albums. The storefront must feel slick on both desktop and mobile, reflect a clean “modern” aesthetic, and keep page load times low so listeners stay engaged.
Core functionality • Every product page should include an embedded streaming preview of the track or album. Listeners hit Play, hear a 30–60 second sample, and decide on the spot whether to buy. • Once purchased, customers receive an automated, secure download link. No manual fulfilment. • Shoppers can leave ratings and written reviews that display below the track details to boost social proof. • Checkout needs to accept major credit & debit cards (Stripe is fine) and PayPal. I’m open to adding more gateways later, but those two must be live from day one.
Scope of work – Design a lightweight, responsive theme or child-theme that nails the modern look while staying easy for me to update. A theme has been installed but I am not attached to using it. – Set up product templates for single tracks, EPs, and full albums, each with preview, price, and review section ready to go. – Configure audio-preview and secure-download plugins (WooCommerce Product Audio Preview, Downloadable Product permissions, or similar—your call) so they work seamlessly. – Integrate Stripe and PayPal, run test transactions, and hand-over written steps so I can reconcile orders. – Basic on-page SEO (titles, meta, schema for music) and performance tweaks so the store scores well on Core Web Vitals. – Final walkthrough and a quick video or PDF guide showing me how to add new releases.
Acceptance criteria 1. A visitor can preview, purchase, pay with card or PayPal, receive a download link, and leave a review—all without errors. 2. Site front-end scores 90+ on Google PageSpeed for mobile. 3. Design remains consistent across Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge, and current iOS/Android browsers.
If this sounds like a build you can knock out cleanly, let’s talk timeline and milestones.
Here is what I came up with myself:
ROBERTLEECAMPMUSIC.COM
Wordpress Site using WooCommerce Wordpress and WooCommerce have been installed
Features
A story with photos about my musical journey. like a bio
Songs for sale under categories I create for each song: 1. A description/story about the song 2. An image that I will provide 3. Ability to listen to the song, without downloading 4. Ability to listen to the original recording of the song, without downloading 5. Able to purchase the song as a download, in two formats: a. mp3 file b. wav file
A group of free to download songs that I recorded, mostly around 1 minute each

item.title: Modern Minimalistic Cleaning Website
item.description:
1500-3000 AUD | # Website Design & Development – Green Clean Systems
We are looking for an experienced **website designer/developer to build a completely new website from scratch** for Green Clean Systems, an established cleaning company servicing Sydney.
This is a **new website build, not a redesign**.
### Our Goal
We want a modern, premium and professional website that:
* Positions Green Clean Systems as a serious commercial cleaning company * Generates high-quality enquiries and quote requests * Builds trust and credibility * Clearly showcases our services * Works exceptionally well on mobile * Provides a strong foundation for SEO and digital marketing
### Brand & Positioning
The website should have a **premium, modern corporate feel** rather than looking like a generic cleaning company template.
Important elements we want incorporated include:
* Triple ISO Certification * Existing clients and testimonials * Our **First Clean Experience** offer * Commercial, residential and specialist cleaning services * Strong Sydney/local presence
### Content
**We will provide the website copy and relevant business information.**
We need the successful freelancer to focus primarily on **design, UX, development and creating a high-converting website structure**.
### We Are Looking For
Someone with demonstrated experience in:
* Premium website design * UX/UI * Lead-generation websites * Conversion optimisation * Responsive/mobile design * SEO-friendly development
We are open to **WordPress, Webflow or another suitable platform** and would like your recommendation.
### Proposal
Please provide:
1. 3 examples of your best website work 2. Your recommended platform 3. Estimated timeframe 4. Fixed project price 5. What is included 6. Any ongoing costs 7. Briefly explain your approach to creating a website that generates enquiries
**Please do not send a generic proposal. We want someone who has actually read the brief and can demonstrate a strong understanding of premium website design and lead generation.**
There is potential for ongoing work after the initial website build, including landing pages, SEO pages and digital marketing assets.

item.title: Award-Winning Business needs a Website Revamp
item.description:
250-750 AUD | PROJECT OVERVIEW I need a skilled contractor to perform updates and add two new pages to my existing WIX website. We are a South Australian signage business that recently won a major (national) industry award and want to promote it to human visitors, while simultaneously launching a technical AI-search optimization (GEO) strategy.
SCOPE OF WORK 1. Minor Wix Site Updates to Landing Page: Updating the landing page into a visually engaging, high-converting landing page celebrating the award win, designed primarily for human visitors and clients. Integrate award badges, banners, links or photos onto our existing homepage or header.
2. Pages 2 and 3 (GEO Information Hubs): Two brand new pages designed and written strictly for Generative Engine Optimization (GEO). The copy on these pages must be highly structured, information-dense, and formatted (such as direct Q&A blocks) so AI search engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews can easily crawl, cite, and reference us.
3. Technical Implementation: Ensure Wix’s NLWeb protocol is enabled, and deploy custom JSON-LD Schema Markup (Award and Organization schema) via the Wix Advanced SEO dashboard.
REQUIRED SKILLS • Deep experience with the Wix platform. • Clear understanding of GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) and LLM indexing behaviour. • Strong English copywriting skills for writing both marketing copy (for the award page) and factual, entity-heavy copy (for the GEO pages). • Experience generating and embedding custom JSON-LD schema.
Please specify your experience with Wix SEO/GEO tools and your approach to structured content writing in your bid.
*** Start your proposal with the word SW2026WIN or it will be auto-deleted ***
There may be the opportunity for further tasks or ongoing work if you are the right fit for our business. Thank you for the time.

item.title: SoDak Sweettique Website & Logo
item.description:
250-750 USD | I’m launching an online candy shop and need a complete brand presence built from scratch. The project breaks down into two connected parts: a playful, memorable logo that captures the joy of candy, and a fully-functional e-commerce website where customers can browse, review, and buy sweets with ease.
For the site itself, I’ll need three core pages—Home, Product Catalog, and Contact—each responsive and consistent with the logo’s look and feel. Essential functionality includes a smooth shopping cart and checkout flow plus a section where buyers can leave user reviews and ratings.

The logo should be delivered in vector format (AI, SVG, EPS) alongside web-ready PNGs, with colour and monochrome versions. The site hand-off should include source files, any theme or plugin licences, and a brief guide showing me how to add new products and moderate reviews.
Once live, I’ll run a quick pass to confirm: • Visual consistency between logo and site • Checkout completes without errors on both desktop and mobile • Reviews can be submitted and displayed correctly
If that sounds clear, let’s get started—I’m excited to see your sweetest ideas.

item.title: Mobile IV Booking Website Build
item.description:
250-750 USD | I’m ready to launch a professional-looking website for my mobile IV therapy service and I need the full build handled from design through go-live. The core of the site will be a streamlined booking system where visitors can pick a treatment, choose an available time slot, and secure their appointment in just a few clicks. I also want each service page to carry customer reviews so new clients see real-world results before they book.
Design must feel clean, medical-grade professional—think crisp typography, calm colour palette and intuitive navigation. While an e-commerce cart isn’t necessary, the booking flow should still capture contact details, requested location, treatment add-ons and any promo codes, then send automated confirmations and reminders.

If you have previous medical, wellness or on-demand service site experience, please mention it when you respond.

item.title: Wix-TutorBird Migration Expert
item.description:
10-500 GBP | I want to move my entire teaching website from Wix to TutorBird without losing any of the functionality I plan on having on it.
On Wix a booking system is currently being built and a series of automations - these are bookings for trial classes within free spaces in group classes. Then email automations will follow for these classes, so students know how to join the class on Lessonspace. Payment needs to be taken and invoices will need to be sent for the trial class and if parents decide to pay for the term then an option to pay will be sent to them and there will be an option to pay for the term/monthly/yearly on the website too. If they do not decide to join the class after the trial class the space becomes empty again for someone else.
Payment options will be termly payments (with an option to pay for either the full term or in monthly instalments), or a yearly payment. Payments will be made from abroad to the UK. Therefore UK and other time zones need to be shown on the calendar.
So far I have a freebie lead magnet pdf ready and set up on my wix - this is sent to someone once they sign up for the freebie on my website. I will be collecting an email list this way and would like this to be saved on tutorbird. Once they receive the freebie they are sent 4 automated emails over 5 days. They are also directed to a page that leads them on to next steps like following my socials or joining a masterclass. I need a developer who can replicate those workflows inside TutorBird as closely as the platform allows. I need to make this as automated as possible. I will also be sending newsletters.
I currently do not have any contacts/students/emails to transfer from wix to tutorbird.
I need to also build a page which will give people the opportunity to join free and paid masterclasses that I host.
In the future I will need to build a tripwire funnel and a page that upsells resources.
Core functionality to reproduce • Booking system – regular lessons and a “trial class if a seat is free” option, both syncing seamlessly with my calendar. - Payment options for monthly (term split into monthly payments), termly payment and yearly payment options • Automated emails – welcome, reminders, upsells, and any future funnels. • Lead-magnet delivery – instant PDF by opt-in links. • Automated invoicing – with international payment gateways that keep fees low. • Future-proofing – the ability to bolt on a trip-wire funnel and sell resources at checkout, plus pages for upcoming free and paid masterclasses.
Design continuity matters too: I want the current Wix layout, colour palette, and typography rebuilt inside TutorBird so the switch feels close to invisible to my audience since my brand feel matters to me. Or better if the professional knows how to make it flow and feel better for the user. It also needs to be editable for me so that I can make changes where necessary. If design continuity is not possible in tutorbird then I might not consider the project since my brand is very important to me.
Acceptance criteria 1. A fully functioning TutorBird site that mirrors my Wix design. 2. All automations listed above tested live with sample data. 3. Step-by-step documentation so I can tweak or extend the setup myself later.
If you have hands-on experience with TutorBird, Wix, Stripe or similar payment integrations, and email automation tools (TutorBird’s native system), I’d love to hear how you would tackle this migration and the estimated timeline and cost (as I am on a budget as a small business and sole trader in my first year- budget of £0-400). I also use lessonspace to deliver my lessons and would like this to be integrated.
My current website is: www.knowmadictutoring.com (the class booking system is still being built but I have a html of the draft which is attached to this brief)

item.title: Google Sheets WooCommerce Stock Control
item.description:
250-750 GBP | I run two WooCommerce stores and I’m looking for a straightforward stock-control spreadsheet that lives in Google Sheets. The goals are simple:
• Pull the current inventory for every SKU from both WooCommerce sites into one sheet and keep it fresh throughout the day (hourly sync is fine). • Hold a minimum stock level and a preferred reorder quantity for each item. • Trigger a clear low-stock alert in the sheet (conditional colour change or email/SMS via Apps Script—whichever is quickest to maintain) whenever the on-hand figure dips below the minimum. • As soon as an item flags low, automatically create a ready-to-send purchase order tab or PDF using the stored supplier details and the predefined reorder quantity.
I don’t need elaborate dashboards—just reliable automation, clean formulas, and lightweight Apps Script so anyone on the team can follow what’s happening. Please build directly in my Google Workspace, comment the scripts, and include a brief setup guide so I can add new SKUs or suppliers later without touching code.
